headline: Cell phone procedures at BHS and BMS, a MaineHousing award for a student homeless prevention program, and a weight room renovation update.
summary: The meeting covers cell phone procedures for Biddeford High School and Biddeford Middle School, an accreditation update, and a second reading of a policy on visitors to the schools. It also includes a presentation, staff nominations, appointments, resignations, and transfers.
items: Presentation: Tara Rivera, Welcome Center Director
